_about: Rose Hill Gymnasium (decisions/0023, updated), home of Fordham basketball since 1925 and the Gothic end of the complex, about a third the size of McShane: a slate roof with a raised clerestory along the ridge, and a fieldstone gable front with a pointed window over three wooden doors.
